I don’t have real‑time access to live exchange‑rate feeds, so I can only give you an approximate figure based on recent market averages.

As of the most recent data I’ve seen, the USD/GBP rate has hovered around **0.77–0.78**. Using a mid‑point of **0.775**, $20 would be roughly:

\[
\$20 \times 0.775 \;=\; £15.50
\]

So you can expect about **£15½** for $20, but keep in mind that the exact amount will vary with the current market rate and any transaction fees your bank or payment service may apply. If you need the precise figure for a particular day, it’s best to check a reliable financial news source or your banking app.
